approximation_notice: The recording is an approximation to an emitted source waveform. It already contains the original microphone response, indoor propagation, background sound and any source motion; this reuse does not establish absolute SPL or detection range.

recordings.title: Dji Mavic Mini 2 hover above ground UP-DOWN XY mic placement Zoom H5.wav
recordings.creator: Sadiquecat
recordings.permission_summary: The source page declares Creative Commons Zero and permits copying, modification and redistribution without permission.
recordings.recording_conditions: Indoor DJI Mavic Mini 2 hover recording; Zoom H5 stock XY microphone on a bench; uploader states that the material was only segmented and may contain footsteps or remote-control beeps.
recordings.simulation_preprocessing: Decode HQ OGG preview, average channels, resample to 48 kHz, remove DC, FFT-bandlimit to the declared 10 kHz emitted edge, and peak-normalize to 0.95. Absolute level is intentionally discarded.
recordings.split_limitation: Calibration and evaluation intervals are disjoint but belong to the same recording session, so they are not independent source-data trials. Results are limited to an integration demonstration.
